'''Flash Wolves''' is a professional esports based in [[:Category:Taiwan|Taiwan]]. 

==History==
'''Flash Wolves''' was founded as '''yoe IRONMEN''' in April 2013 before rebranding to '''Flash Wolves''' in August 2013, since then, it has been the top team in the Taiwanese LoL championship for many years, winning a total of 6 LMS championships as well as IEM Taipei. In December 2019, it was announced that '''Flash Wolves''' will not participate in the new merged league of Taiwan and South East Asia, PCS, marking an end for the team after being active in League of Legends for 6 years.
